movelist.name: Ingrain
movelist.effect: Ingrain applies a Coat to the user, which has the following effect; the user cannot be pushed or pulled, and cannot be switched out.  At the beginning of each of the user’s turn, the user gains a Tick of Hit Points.

movelist.name: Leech Seed
movelist.effect: At the beginning of each of the target’s turns, Leech Seed’s target loses a Tick of Hit Points. Leech Seed’s user then gains Hit Points equal to the amount the target lost. Leech Seed lasts until the target faints or is returned to a Poké Ball. Grass Types and targets immune to Grass Attacks are immune to Leech Seed.

movelist.name: Mega Drain
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Worry Seed
movelist.effect: You choose one of the target’s Abilities. Worry Seed changes that Ability to Insomnia for the remainder of the encounter.

movelist.name: Razor Leaf
movelist.effect: Razor Leaf is a Critical Hit on 18+.

abilities.name: Sun Blanket
abilities.effect: The user gains a Tick of Hit Points. Sun Blanket may only be triggered while the user is under 50% Hit Points or in Sunny Weather.

abilities.name: Chlorophyll
abilities.effect: While in Sunny Weather or under 50% Max Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.
